title: Staged traffic migration with gating and LTS channel awareness for Hosted API
creator: Ava Chen
description:
Goal: Harden the Hosted API deployment pipeline for model/runtime upgrades by implementing a staged traffic migration flow that understands version channels (stable/LTS vs latest), enforces rollout gates, and provides automated rollback/mitigation tooling. This work covers orchestration changes, telemetry gating, console controls for operators, and runbook updates.

Scope:
- Introduce an orchestration stage that performs multi-step traffic migration (0->1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%) with programmable hold/gate checks.
- Gate checks will evaluate: error-budget burn (5m/1h), P95 latency regressions, increase in 5xx rate, client-visible schema or auth failures, and model output-quality regressions from the eval suite.
- Ensure rollout logic is channel-aware: LTS/stable channels default to conservative step durations and require more stringent gates; latest experiments can opt into faster heuristics.
- Integrate console UI controls for manual pause/override, and an API for automated traffic-shift jobs.
- Add safe rollback hooks that immediately cut traffic to previous variant and emit structured incident metadata.

Acceptance criteria:
- Pipeline supports staged percentage steps and configurable wait/halt thresholds exposed in console and via API.
- Gates implemented with clear signal definitions and telemetry dashboards per step.
- Automated rollback executes within 30s of gate failure and creates an incident ticket with root cause pointers.
- Rollouts honor release channel labels and default policies (e.g., LTS -> 48hr conservative vs latest -> 6hr fast).
- Runbook and oncall playbook updated and validated in chaos/drill.

Out of scope for this ticket: model packaging changes, per-tenant custom policies (handled in follow-ups).
comments: 2026-03-05 - Ava Chen: Created initial ticket after postmortem for 2026-02-28 partial rollout incident. Main ask: reduce blast radius for cross-region upgrades and ensure LTS customers get stricter defaults.

2026-03-06 - Marcus Bell: Spike completed for traffic-shifting primitives in the orchestration layer. Found that current router lacks atomic percentage controls across regions; prototype uses token-bucket gating on edge-proxies (notes in spike doc).

2026-03-08 - Priya Singh (PM): Prioritize telemetry signals: error budget burn, P95 latency, client schema errors, and eval-quality score delta. PM + Observability agreed to ship signal dashboards by Mar 13.

2026-03-09 - Marcus Bell: Design decision: implement gating as a two-phase check - fast health signals (latency/5xx) for immediate halts, and background QA checks (eval-suite) that can trigger progressive rollback if quality drops beyond threshold. Trade-off: slightly longer overall rollout but much lower risk of silent quality regressions.

2026-03-10 - Design review: Console UX mockups reviewed. UX requests an explicit channel selector (stable/LTS/latest) and a templated policy editor. DES feedback: show step-level telemetry inline so operators can decide to continue/pause without navigating. Linked design spec in attachments.

2026-03-11 - Marcus Bell: Implemented controller changes to express step plans and gating conditions in YAML. Open PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/5842. Needs infra review for edge proxy token-bucket semantics and config rollout safety.

2026-03-12 - Observability (Diego Ramos): Dashboard panels created for rollout state. Added alert rules: (1) 5xx rate increase >0.5% absolute AND >200 requests in 5m, (2) P95 latency regressed >30% vs baseline for 5m. Alerts currently in test namespace. Will wire to gating API tomorrow.

2026-03-12 - Marcus Bell: Next steps: finalize gating thresholds, add automated rollback handler (30s fast fail), update runbooks, and schedule a dev-stage rollout on 2026-03-17. Blocking: infra needs a short-lived config change to support atomic percentage shift across regions.
2026-03-12 - Security (Maya Patel): Confirmed no new auth surface for the controller API. Recommend audit log enrichment for policy changes. Marking security_review_required=true.

2026-03-12 - Marcus Bell: Created a short checklist for verification before canary: (1) baseline traffic profile captured, (2) eval-suite job runs for candidate release, (3) rollback playbook tested in chaos env.
